requiredObligations.description: Must diagnose infeasibility of PF₁⊥PF₂ on x²/5+y²/4=1 instead of dropping (2) or fabricating P

unsupportedReasons: Subquestion (2) condition P ∈ C ∧ PF₁ ⊥ PF₂ is mathematically infeasible on x²/5 + y²/4 = 1 because c=1 < b=2 implies max ∠F₁PF₂ = 2 arctan(1/2) < 90°.
